name: GDELT
tagline: Global news monitoring APIs for full-text, geo, and TV coverage search
description: The GDELT Project monitors worldwide broadcast, print, and web news and exposes free realtime JSON APIs (DOC, GEO, TV, Context) for full-text search, geographic mapping, television monitoring, and contextual snippets. Data is also available as bulk downloads and via Google BigQuery. No signup or API key is required for the public v2 APIs at api.gdeltproject.org.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints accept query parameters only; no API key, OAuth, or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public APIs; no paid tier on api.gdeltproject.org. Soft limit typically treated as ~1 request per 5 seconds by community clients; no official free-tier quota page.

rate_limits: Not formally published with hard numbers on official docs; community clients and GDELT MCP enforce ~1 request per 5 seconds. Exceeding may yield errors or throttling.
use_cases: search recent global news articles by keyword or phrase
chart news volume over time for a topic
map geographic mentions of a keyword in world news
analyze tone/sentiment distribution of media coverage
search TV news transcripts by network or market
pull contextual sentence snippets matching a query
